title: Platinum Engine v0.1.0 bounded release evidence
supersedes: The 2026-10-27 release-acceptance-v1 proposal, retained literally in the private research tree; this document does not rewrite its historical observations.

author.identity_note: Assigned role; workstation metadata separately reports openai-codex/gpt-6.1-terra; runtime model identity not independently verified.

contract.target: For identical source bytes and independently established effective settings, compare complete unmodified output files including encoded audio, headers, tags, padding, markers and relevant timestamps; do not normalize to manufacture a match.
contract.reference: Platinum Notes 10.5.0.1256, macOS arm64; portable component reference Apple M4 with SME, macOS 27.2 build 26B123 where the component receipt says so.
contract.linux: Linux aarch64 and x86_64 target macOS byte identity on admitted paths; named unsupported operations are refused or reported unavailable. Finite evidence does not prove every input, and known x86 floating-point residuals are not all guarded at runtime.
contract.interpretation: This is a finite evidence index and does not establish universal equivalence, legal clearance, an independent acceptance sign-off, or permission to publish. Historical nondeterminism and user-selected safety divergences are not counted as parity passes.
contract.overlap: Component, native replay, workflow and test sets overlap; do not sum them as unique cases.

v1_blocker_updates.update: MP4 originals still differ by header seconds; the selected diagnostic contract compares each export at its recorded second. The historical dd4b5fd0 binary matched ten such exports. No clock-phase or general repeatability claim follows.
The nonzero Xing caller-byte branch is supported by static in-process handle analysis and matched the retained E05 exports; the actual running native caller byte was not observed.

An unsynchronized native dispatch-table reset can explain the documented batch pitch-marker outliers; the selected target is the race-free native value. Historical outliers remain nondeterministic observations, not matches.

All captured alignment-sensitive native exports match the aligned-0 FFT profile, now explicitly used by the engine; literal GUI scratch addresses and every future allocation profile remain unobserved.

Nine representative families had no-flag strict reviews for the historical dd4b5fd0 binary. Later replays with relocated output directories have their own context limitations and are not identical-path strict reviews.

Historical Ogg/OGA picker, folder, bounded drag and explicit-open observations do not establish general drag admission or decoder invocation. Collision refusal without explicit overwrite is an Engine safety policy.
The historical dd4b5fd0 release matched six nonzero-width dynamics-gate cases and nine pitch-threshold counterparts; these finite cases do not cover all controls.

The historical dd4b5fd0 replay did not use the exact native backup path; replacement markers include that path. The later c9f19077 candidate matched the bounded W04 exact-path replacement/restore comparison.
Waveform and workflow evidence remains bounded; independently signed acceptance, exhaustive parity and legal clearance are not inferred.

known_limits: x86_64 ordinary FTZ tininess-after-rounding versus ARM tininess-before-rounding; default-NaN sign; NaN payload selection including vectorized FMA operand order; sampled min/max signed-zero and NaN behavior. Not every affected runtime input is detected; Linux aarch64 is stricter.
Accelerate FFT/vDSP dispatch varies by Apple hardware and alignment; other Apple Silicon or macOS versions and AudioToolbox AAC stack context may produce different reference bits.

Linux refuses MP3/AAC decoding, AAC encoding, unmodeled sample-rate conversion, required artwork transcoding, unverified codec variants/GSM masks, ALAC native-loss cases, unapproved libraries and ambiguous marker/container cases. Non-44.1 kHz waveforms are reported unavailable.
Conservative source-status-3, unknown-container, malformed candidate-marker and duplicate AIFF ID3 handling are safety policies, not claims of native admission parity.

Deliberately conflicting GEOBs within one ID3 tag, duplicate MP4 freeform items or FLAC Xiph-versus-ID3 markers may hide a later processed marker; sync-like junk or separated ID3 tags may also evade prefix discovery. These are accepted source-review scenarios; exact decoder admission was not established.

A library identity check cannot prevent a concurrently writable library inode from changing before native initialization; use trusted, immutable-to-other-writers storage. Docker Desktop bind-mount identity mismatches were reported; use in-image libraries and volume/tmpfs state.
No new native GUI drag-and-drop admission test was performed in this release cycle without desktop-control approval; picker/open routes were observed. Historical bounded Ogg/OGA drags are separate.

MP4 reference exports contain wall-clock seconds; controlled-clock comparisons use each reference's recorded second. Batch pitch-marker outliers, native process variability, and user-selected refusal of invalid 32 kHz AAC remain explicit limits.
Distribution packages and source/relink materials require maintainer license and derivative-status review; nothing here is a legal clearance or publication authorization.
